categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen Jiarong Technology Corp. focuses on membrane separation technology, providing high-performance membrane materials and components, membrane separation equipment, high-concentration wastewater treatment services, and resource recycling solutions. Its products and services are mainly applied in landfill leachate treatment, industrial wastewater treatment and reuse, industrial process separation, and resource recycling. The company also engages in environmental engineering construction and operates in both domestic and international markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced membrane separation technologies including microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, and reverse osmosis membranes. It develops specialized membrane components such as DT (Disc Tube), ST (Spacer Tube), and industrial special separation membranes with acid, alkali, and solvent resistance. Manufacturing employs CNC machining and robotic welding, with SAP system integration for resource management. The company also develops high-performance low-temperature vacuum evaporation equipment and integrates biochemical, oxidation, and evaporation technologies for comprehensive wastewater treatment solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include environmental engineering firms, investment operators, public utility management units, and large to medium-sized industrial enterprises, including well-known listed companies and leading environmental groups in China. The company serves municipal solid waste landfill leachate treatment, industrial wastewater treatment, and emerging sectors such as new energy battery materials, semiconductor, and wet smelting industries. Overseas markets include Europe, Singapore, Brazil, Colombia, Malaysia, and Vietnam.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across 27 provinces and autonomous regions in China, including four municipalities. It has established subsidiaries and offices in the United States, Germany, Singapore, and Vietnam to support international sales and service. Its overseas sales network covers Europe, Southeast Asia, and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiamen Jiarong Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental technology supply chain. It manufactures membrane materials and components (midstream), assembles membrane separation equipment, and provides high-concentration wastewater treatment services and resource recycling solutions (downstream). The company also offers engineering construction and operation services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-performance membrane materials and components, aiming for domestic substitution of imported products. Key R&D projects include development of acid/alkali/solvent-resistant membranes, high-pressure membranes, low-temperature vacuum evaporation technology, and biochemical treatment processes for complex wastewater. It integrates AI and IoT technologies for smart operation and remote monitoring. The company also focuses on expanding applications in emerging industries such as new energy materials and semiconductor wastewater treatment, and enhancing its global market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of membrane separation equipment, membrane components, and consumables, as well as service fees from high-concentration wastewater treatment contracts. The company employs a direct sales model, including commercial negotiations, bidding, and competitive tendering. It also offers equipment leasing and post-sale operation services, charging based on treatment volume, providing flexible financial solutions to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Xiamen Jiarong Technology is positioned as a leading domestic enterprise in membrane technology for landfill leachate and high-concentration wastewater treatment, belonging to the first tier in membrane component and equipment manufacturing in China. It competes with both domestic and international membrane technology providers, leveraging its comprehensive product line, quality, and integrated service capabilities to maintain competitive advantages. The company emphasizes technology innovation and brand building to differentiate itself in a competitive market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 555.8 million, a slight increase of 0.19% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 50.2 million, a decrease of 13.55%. The company’s total assets reached approximately RMB 2.23 billion, with a stable equity base. Overseas business revenue grew by 41.2%, indicating expanding international market penetration. The company maintains positive operating cash flow and continues investing in R&D and industrial infrastructure, reflecting a steady growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a full-process, customizable membrane technology solution integrating membrane materials, components, equipment, and services, enabling efficient, stable, and cost-effective treatment of complex high-concentration wastewater. Its products feature superior separation performance, durability, and resistance to harsh chemical environments. Standardized, modular equipment designs allow rapid deployment and scalability, reducing project costs and timelines. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, quality assurance, and comprehensive after-sales service create a robust competitive moat and high customer satisfaction.
